name: Vampiric Burst
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 4, arcanist 6, magus 6, mesmerist 6, psychic 7, sorcerer 6, spiritualist 6, witch 6, wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.
Area 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You drain life from beings around you, dealing 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels to every living creature within the spell’s area (excluding yourself). A Fortitude save halves this damage. You gain temporary hit points equal to the damage you deal. You can’t gain more temporary hit points from each subject than its current hit points + its Constitution score (which is enough to kill the subject). These temporary hit points stack with themselves (up to a maximum of 5 per caster level) and disappear 1 hour later.

Mythic The spell’s damage increases to 1d8 points of damage per 2 caster levels, and the maximum temporary hit points you can gain from this spell increase to 10 per caster level.

Augmented (7th): If you expend two uses of mythic power and the damage kills a creature, you gain fast healing 5 for a number of rounds equal to the Hit Dice of the target. If the spell kills multiple targets, the duration of this fast healing stacks.
